selected_result: Equation (2.7), first-order expansion of general binary-tree summation error

bibliographic_source.title: Deterministic and Probabilistic Error Bounds for Floating Point Summation Algorithms

paper_locations.anchor: Equation (2.7), first-order deterministic expansion derived after Theorem 2.4

task_clarification: For arbitrary real leaves and arbitrary finite binary summation tree of height h, each internal addition obeys the standard relative-error equation on its computed child operands with |delta_k|<=u.

Formalize equation (2.7): final forward error equals the sum of exact internal partial sums s_k times their corresponding delta_k, up to a uniform O(h^2*u^2) remainder scaled to the fixed input vector. Include the one-leaf zero-error case.
This first-order expansion is selected independently of the printed last inequality in Theorem 2.4, which has a separate apparent typo; do not formalize that false inequality as part of this task.
scope_constraints: Do not specialize to sequential or pairwise-only summation, nonnegative inputs, or a single tree shape.
The computed result must be an actual tree evaluation and local witnesses must be linked to each internal rounded addition.
Do not postulate the first-order expansion or hide the remainder in an unconstrained input.
